button.label: Insert Interlinear
button.screentip: Insert an interlinear example from the clipboard
button.supertip: Copy an interlinear selection in FLEx and click here. Every example in the copy is drawn in a text box on the current slide, one under another, lined up with tab stops and wrapped to the box's width. Widen or narrow the box and it re-wraps.

button.label: Re-wrap This
button.screentip: Re-wrap the selected examples to their boxes' width
button.supertip: Reads the text back (what you typed counts), measures, plans and draws again. A re-wrap that changes nothing writes nothing.

button.label: Re-wrap All
button.screentip: Re-wrap every example in the presentation

button.label: Renumber
button.screentip: Number every example in order: slide by slide, top to bottom
button.supertip: Numbers here are text, so they do not renumber themselves. A group from one copy keeps its letters: (2a), (2b).

button.label: Split Column
button.screentip: Split the column at the cursor
button.supertip: Click into a cell first. Pulls an affix, clitic or reduplicant out into a column of its own, carrying the morpheme break character onto the new column on every tier.

button.label: Merge Columns
button.supertip: Select across cells to merge exactly those; with the cursor in one cell, that column is merged with the one after it.

toggleButton.label: By Word
toggleButton.screentip: One column per word: the selected examples now, new examples from here on
toggleButton.supertip: Enclitics stay in their host's column.

toggleButton.label: By Morpheme
toggleButton.screentip: One column per morpheme: the selected examples now, new examples from here on
toggleButton.supertip: Enclitic columns never start a wrap line.

toggleButton.label: Numbers
toggleButton.supertip: Stored in this presentation. Renumber puts every example in order.

toggleButton.label: First Capital
toggleButton.screentip: Grammatical glosses as Erg / 3Sg; off, uniform small capitals

toggleButton.label: Re-wrap on Resize
toggleButton.screentip: Re-wrap an example when its box is resized
toggleButton.supertip: On by default. Fires when the handle is let go.

button.label: Check Glossing
button.screentip: Check the selected example against the glossing conventions
button.supertip: Reports columns whose cells disagree about a morpheme break character, spaces inside cells, form and gloss showing a different number of breaks, and unmatched infix brackets. Offers to fix the ones with a single right answer.
